name: @hkay-dev/ohmystash
description: OhMyStash (OMS), a durable chat-scoped and global prompt manager for Oh My Pi.

scripts.capture:browser: bun run showcase/patch-wterm-cells.ts && OMS_CAPTURE_FEATURE=scope tcut showcase/ohmystash-browser.video.ts --force --cast /tmp/ohmystash-browser.cast && bun run showcase/check-border-alignment.ts assets/ohmystash-browser.png && OMS_CAPTURE_FEATURE=search tcut showcase/ohmystash-browser.video.ts --force --cast /tmp/ohmystash-search.cast && OMS_CAPTURE_FEATURE=queue-draft tcut showcase/ohmystash-browser.video.ts --force --cast /tmp/ohmystash-queue-draft.cast && OMS_CAPTURE_FEATURE=submit-queue tcut showcase/ohmystash-browser.video.ts --force --cast /tmp/ohmystash-submit-queue.cast && OMS_CAPTURE_FEATURE=attachments tcut showcase/ohmystash-browser.video.ts --force --cast /tmp/ohmystash-attachments.cast && OMS_CAPTURE_FEATURE=editing tcut showcase/ohmystash-browser.video.ts --force --cast /tmp/ohmystash-editing.cast && OMS_CAPTURE_FEATURE=locking-deletion tcut showcase/ohmystash-browser.video.ts --force --cast /tmp/ohmystash-locking-deletion.cast
scripts.capture:all: bun run capture:browser && bun run capture:settings

omp.name: OhMyStash
omp.description: OhMyStash (OMS) provides durable prompt storage, scoped browsing, search, editing, and queue restoration.

Stash shortcut.description: Stash the current prompt, or restore the latest prompt from this chat when the editor is empty. Enter none to disable it. Shortcut changes apply in a new OMP session.

Browser shortcut.description: Open the saved-prompt browser. Enter none to disable it. Shortcut changes apply in a new OMP session.

Editor command.description: Command used by e to edit a stash, such as nvim or code --wait. Blank uses OMP's registered VISUAL/EDITOR command, then falls back to OMP's built-in multi-line editor.

Browser layout.description: Choose how saved prompts and previews are arranged. Automatic adapts to the terminal size.

Maximum body rows.description: Limit the height of the prompt list and preview area. The default is twice the original browser height.

Time format.description: Choose how exact stash timestamps appear in previews and notifications.

Retention days.description: Delete unlocked normal stashes older than this many days. Set 0 to keep them indefinitely. Locked, conflict, and recovery entries are never expired.

Dim background.description: Reduce the prominence of the OMP session behind the prompt browser.

Background brightness (%).description: Set how much background brightness remains while the prompt browser is open.

Background saturation (%).description: Set how much background color remains while the prompt browser is open.

Show icons.description: Use icons from the active OMP symbol theme in the prompt browser.
